verdict.rationale: Grok Build documents running checks. AGENTS.md can hold build and test commands the agent follows, hooks can run actions such as a formatter after edits, and background monitors can watch CI runs. However, nothing in the pack documents a diff view or a review step for changes before merging. missing for 10: a documented diff inspection/review UI, an explicit pre-merge review or check-gating workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect diffs and run checks to catch problems before merging

citations.quote: Put coding conventions, build and test commands, and architecture notes in an `AGENTS.md` at your repo root, and Grok follows them without being told each session.
block a dangerous command before it runs, log tool use, run a formatter after edits
Grok can run commands, subagents, and monitors in the background while the conversation continues.
each line the script prints becomes a notification in the conversation. Ask for one when you want to watch a log, a CI run, or a port
